description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Infested Thrinax, adding {B}.
When Infested Thrinax dies, it triggers for each time it entered the battlefield this turn, creating a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens equal to its power for each trigger.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {B}.
Repeat step 5 until you either control no Saprolings, or until you have {5}{B}{B} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Infested Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
